evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the internal HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Fixes a race condition in the HTTP server where a pipelined request followed by a 'Connection: close' can result in dropped responses if the I/O thread disconnects prematurely. While it addresses an unexpected disconnection bug, pipelining with closing connections is an edge case in typical RPC workloads.
